title: CI error in bolus calculations
body:
I've never had this bug before. I started dinner, used the wizard to bolus and validated (not really checking the numbers). Then, when it started injecting, I saw over 7U to be given... My dinner is often less than 5U. I stopped immediately the injection. 

My Dev version

![Screenshot_20231104_164457_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/c1007c9b-9bc2-420b-8ace-dea7b6f36881)

I had my COVID injection and BG numbers were stuck a bit high. I set several times profile at 160% for 15-20 minutes to lower the BGs before dinner.

![Screenshot_20231104_200311_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/668b809b-d0b7-4502-aedc-e8fc51e5d1fd)

But the last one was long before dinner.

![Screenshot_20231104_195803_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/f9dff99e-66fc-4e42-9982-5db5c8385f07)

This is my profile

![Screenshot_20231104_195415_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/03833362-316b-4d32-afe9-1bdb1d04cd28)

And this is the calc results... The CI doesn't correspond to anything (not even 160% of my profile CI).

![Screenshot_20231104_195338_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/87a99ee6-2748-4b8c-ae27-e4697c7272fd)

When I used the wizard a second time, all worked ok as usual.

And the logs. Look around 19:52

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1699124288583.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13257554/AndroidAPS_LOG_1699124288583.log.zip)

comments.body:
I didn't see any bug in logs. Always was calculated with correct IC, except result of Wizard.
The only possible reason I see is you selected another profile for calculation in dialog. Don't you have one with IC 4,3?
BolusWizard dialog is not covered by detailed logging to be able say what did you select

I just checked and none of my profiles use a CI of 4.3 🤔

If there is no info in the logs, nothing we can do. Those repetitive actions we do without really putting in our full attention, I can't see how but maybe I did something strange... 

I'll close this issue and keep an eye open when using the wizard.
